steps.title: Analyze Existing Simple Tap Counter Structure
steps.description: Inspect layouts, view bindings, and state persistence to plan the expansion of custom features seamlessly.

steps.title: Define Multi-Channel Data Structure
steps.description: Establish array variables to support individual counter values, high scores, active steps, and milestone goals for 3 separate channels (Alpha, Beta, Gamma).

steps.title: Integrate Channel Selector Row into XML Layout
steps.description: Design an elegant segmented tab panel at the top of the main layout to easily switch between counter channels.

steps.title: Implement Multi-Channel Switch Logic & State Persistence
steps.description: Connect the tab selections to Java logic, load/save values independently using SharedPreferences, and trigger clean layout refades.

steps.title: Implement the Auto-Pulse (Auto-Clicker) Engine
steps.description: Design an internal timing engine that increments the active channel automatically at 1Hz, 2Hz, or 5Hz based on user config.

steps.title: Add Auto-Pulse Controls to XML Layout
steps.description: Place advanced controls inside a horizontal utility ribbon for switching auto-pulse speeds.

steps.title: Develop Synthesizer Lab Audio Parameters Customizer
steps.description: Expose internal waveform (Sine, Square, Triangle) and Pitch range (Bass, Mid, Treble) settings dynamically through UI state changes.

steps.title: Incorporate Custom Milestone Target Goals
steps.description: Create a customizable target goals system (such as 50, 100, 500, or 1000) for every channel with responsive indicator updates.

steps.title: Build Milestone Flash & Chimes Celebration System
steps.description: Implement full-screen quick-flash animations and rich synthesized chime arpeggios when target limits are reached.

steps.title: Polish Buttons & Lab Settings Panels Styling
steps.description: Refine background gradients, layout padding, text labels, and borders to harmonize beautifully with all gradient themes.

steps.title: Update Ambient Spawner to Sync with Active Channel Steps
steps.description: Recalibrate floating bubble spawning, values, particle colors, and float directions based on selected channels and active features.

steps.title: Validate Main Thread Performance of Multi-Oscillators
steps.description: Optimize synthesis memory allocations and run sound waves cleanly on a background thread to maintain high UI responsiveness.

steps.title: Update Activity Timeline Logging for Lab Events
steps.description: Introduce real-time logging capsule alerts when changing channels, activating the auto-pulse clock, or modifying synth profiles.

steps.title: Building Simple Tap Counter
steps.description: Run strict resource validation, package updates, and execute compilation to create the complete updated build.
